about: How tools/pack.py builds Kobolds & Catacombs 2017 (docs/packs/format.md, 'Build recipes'): on Knights of the Frozen Throne (base), so on Journey to Un'Goro, Mean Streets of Gadgetzan, One Night in Karazhan, Whispers of the Old Gods, The League of Explorers, The Grand Tournament, Blackrock Mountain, Goblins vs Gnomes, Naxxramas and Classic: their cards, patches, scripts, fonts, texts and pictures by reference, without Classic's hand-tuned text layout (skip); then the 135 cards of Kobolds & Catacombs and their tokens as the release build 22611 has them (patch 10.0.0.22611 of 2017-12-06, the day before the release; data/loot_cards.json, tools/extract_cards.py --set loot) with the names and texts of that build for every card of the chain (cards.texts.json, written by the same tool), and this pack's own patch (cards.patch.json: the scripts of scripts/loot*.lua, the keywords, the older cards that changed by then).
